name: brand-landingpage
tagline_zh: 没方向？先聊品牌三连：色彩、字体、形状。它边问边做，直接给你能上线的HTML落地页，改到满意为止。
tagline_en: No direction? It interviews your brand—colors, type, shapes—then ships a deploy-ready landing page, iterating.
desc_en: Brand-first landing page designer — runs a brand-identity interview (colors, typography, shape language), then generates and iterates on a polished landing page via Stitch with deployment-ready HTML. Use when the user asks to create, design, or build a landing page, homepage, or marketing page and has no established visual direction. Skip when they have a design mockup, need a dashboard or app UI,
why_zh: 同类只会套模板，它先挖品牌基因再生成，每次迭代都基于你的真实回答，不是随机换皮。
why_en: Unlike template slingers, it extracts your brand DNA first, then iterates with real context—not random reskins.
